bounds: One owner-scoped approval and its existing scheduled or fired task. Reconciliation retires resolved approvals and their pending prompts before subsequent tick delivery. Read and cleanup failures hold the task and retry on a later tick. Weak fairness assumes eventual successful queue read and cleanup. A dispatch already admitted before a concurrent owner resolution may finish; this model does not claim a cross-store atomic cancellation fence. Live provider outcomes and physical notifications are external. Conformance exercises the real PGlite queue, scheduled store, runner, and tick for both scheduled and fired legacy tasks. Approved or executing requests hold their follow-up without retiring it, preserving a return to pending after execution preflight failure. Only done, rejected and expired requests retire the task.

assumptions: Weak fairness of a successful owner-scoped read and task cleanup.
